# **Drug Stock Tracking**

###### *Version 1*

[Release plan](https://docs.google.com/document/d/13GqbU3nCUAMo8Zf1NU6RJ10yPT5XlqqFRfN3c2ZXFII/edit) Doc

# **Goal**

Basic inventory tracking to improve drug availability for patients. This will allow central staff to see current drug stock, stock trends, and consumption data from a dashboard. Data must be available across IHCI, so we will provide a downloadable data set that meshes well with current spreadsheets.

We should reduce the burden on CVHO/STS on collecting drug stock data from facilities. 

# **Current landscape**

Drug stock is reported by CVHO/STS via spreadsheets that are then shared with RTSL Delhi (and others in IHCI?). This information is used by X to coordinate drug purchases at the state level. It’s also used to redistribute existing stock from larger facilities to smaller clinics.

# **Approach**

Replace spreadsheets with a very basic web form built inside of the Simple dashboard as well as inside the Progress tab in the Simple app.

This form allows any user (including nurses) to report how many of each common hypertension drugs and doses are currently in stock. (e.g. how many Amlodipine 5mg and 10mg are in stock)

Users may report stock for a subset of drugs, and may also report multiple times each month.

A report will be generated on the Simple dashboard to display the most recent and month-wise historical inventory for each drug/dose combination. A heuristic will be used to calculate how many patient days of stock for each drug are on hand.

### Complexities to consider

* We need to know which drugs and doses to track  
* We need to know what category each drug is in (CCB, ARB, diuretic, etc.)  
* **Per state**, we need to know how to calculate patient days in stock  
  * Example: (Amlo 5mg \+ (Amlo 10mg \* 2)) / Patients \* 1.4  
  * **TIM TO GET THE EQUATION LIST**  
* All data needs to be downloadable as a spreadsheet for RTSL Delhi  
* We do not want to track stock for HWC/SC (i.e. community facilities)  
  * Filter by facility size \= community  
* Ideally we show the stock report per district  
  * My Facilities is not currently chunked by district  
  * *This should be a separate project to navigate My Facilities by district*  
* Store every report made, including:  
  * Timestamp the report was submitted  
  * Month the report is for (backdating is possible)  
  * User and facility  
* If multiple reports are submitted for the same drug/dose in the same month, we use the most recent submission  
* The progress tab has not been used as an interactive tool for data submission. How do we handle and show responses, validation errors, success messages, updated state, etc?  
* How do we authenticate form submissions in the web view?

#### Progress tab concerns

* Always display a “Submit report” button  
* If a drug/dose has already been submitted

### What we are intentionally not doing in v1

* No offline support requirement  
* Predicting future stock requirements based on patient registrations  
* Calculating “patient days” of drug stock based on number of patients at each actual step in the protocol.  
* No grouping facilities by hierarchy (HWC → PHC → CHC, etc.)  
* No drug stock report collection for community-level facilities ([ref](https://simpledotorg.slack.com/archives/C01BYR9M933/p1606840739047400))

## Data models

#### NEW MODEL: DrugStock

We will need a new model to contain a record of drug stock at a clinic. This model will represent the stock for a single drug at a facility for a given month, submitted by a user. It should contain the following information:

* `facility_id -` which facility the stock report was submitted for  
* `user_id -` which user submitted the stock report. Can be app user or dashboard user  
* `protocol_drug_id` \- which protocol drug the stock report is for  
* `created_at` \- when the stock report was submitted  
* `recorded_at` \- when the stock information was obtained  
* `in_stock` \- how many are in stock at the end of the month  
* `received` \- how many were received during the month

This model should allow stock to be collected for any ProtocolDrug, as we will choose to track stock for different drugs and doses over time.

\<say something here about stock being monthly re latest editing values for the month\>

We will also need a way to calculate “patient days” of stock remaining for a particular category of drug.

#### UPDATE MODEL: ProtocolDrug

We need to indicate which ProtocolDrug records will have stock tracked as well as what type of medication they are. As such, we need to add the following data to the model:

* `drug_category` \- string enum, e.g. Hypertension ARB, CCB, Diabetes, etc.  
* `stock_tracked` \- boolean, whether or not we track stock

*Note*: If we introduce `protocol_steps` field later to capture which steps a drug is part of, we will keep `stock_tracked` and `protocol_steps` as separate fields to allow us to track stock for non-protocol drugs, or to have protocol drugs that aren’t tracked.

## Stock calculations

Administrators need to calculate how many days of stock they have in each drug category (based on the number of patients registered). These calculations all use the same pattern but vary slightly in practice for each state.

* Each drug/dose combo has a coefficient of how we track pills, e.g. Amlo 5mg is a coeff. of 1, but Amlo 10 has a coeff. of 2 (since patients just take two Amlo 5).  
* Each state has different drug/dose combinations it tracks in stock  
* There is also a Patient coefficient for each drug category (what percent of registered patients are on each category). this may be more than 100%, as they want to keep extra stock in hand for new patients.  
* There is a “Patient load correction factor”, but it’s 100% for every state. We should still bake this in.

For these calculations:

* **Patients:** number of patients assigned  
* **LoadFactor:** patient load correction factor; set for the whole state (always 100% right now)

#### Punjab & Madhya Pradesh

(Amlo5 \+ (Amlo10 \* 2)) / (Patients \* LoadFactor \* 1.4)

(Telmi40 \+ (Telmi80 \* 2\) \+ Los50) / (Patients \* LoadFactor \* 0.37)

(Hydro25 \+ Chlor12.5) / (Patients \* 0.06)

#### Kerala

(Amlo5 \+ (Amlo10 \* 2)) / (Patients \* LoadFactor \* 1.12)

(Telmi40 \+ (Telmi80 \* 2\) \+ (Los25 / 2\) \+ Los50) / (Patients \* LoadFactor \* 0.65)

(Hydro25 \+ Chlor12.5) / (Patients \* 0.05)

#### Telangana

(Amlo5 \+ (Amlo10 \* 2)) / (Patients \* LoadFactor \* 1.4)

(Telmi40 \+ (Telmi80 \* 2\) \+ Los50) / (Patients \* LoadFactor \* 0.37)

(Hydro25 \+ Chlor12.5) / (Patients \* 0.06)

#### Maharashtra

(Amlo5 \+ (Amlo10 \* 2)) / (Patients \* LoadFactor \* 1.12)

(Telmi40 \+ (Telmi80 \* 2\) \+ Los50) / (Patients \* LoadFactor \* 0.65)

(Chlor6.25 \+ (Chlor12.5 \* 2)) / (Patients \* 0.06)

#### MY FACILITIES: DRUG STOCK REPORT

We will create a new section in My Facilities called “Drug stock”.

* ONLY show facility-type PHC and larger:  
  1. Do not show “Community” size facilities  
* Display drug stock for all drugs where `stock_tracked` is true  
* Display the *latest values received* for each drug that month  
* Group drugs by category; the **order of the categories will be hard coded** as follows: (if *any* category is empty, do not show it)  
  1. CCB (e.g. amlodipine)  
  2. ARB (e.g. telmisartan)  
  3. Diuretic (e.g. hydrochlorothiazide)  
  4. Other  
* Display colors for:  
  1. \<90 days (note: not in the mockup below…)   
  2. \<60 days  
  3. \<30 days  
* Display empty/missing stocks as follows:  
  1. No more stock at facility \- User enters “0” explicitly in the report. Dashboard displays “0”  
  2. Unknown stock \- User leaves the stock field blank. Dashboard displays “-”  
  3. Report not submitted \- User hasn’t submitted report for the month. Dashboard displays greyed-out row with “?” in each cell  
* Display “patient days” of stock remaining for each category of medication  
* Display a “Download” link to download the data shown in the report as a CSV file

![][image2]

#### MY FACILITIES: DRUG STOCK REPORT FORM

Users should be enabled to send drug stock reports by clicking a button on the new Drug stock section. This form will automatically include the timestamp the report was `created_at` and the `user_id`. It will also include the following user-submitted information:

* Dropdown for `facility_id`  
* Dropdown for `recorded_at` (can be a “Month \+ Year” dropdown)  
* For each drug/dose combination that we track:  
  * `in_stock` \- how many are in stock at the end of the month  
  * `received` \- how many were received during the month

If a record already exists for a given month, populate the form with the latest values submitted for `in_stock` and `received`. Otherwise, show empty values.

When the form is submitted, store new records (even if they copy the previous values).

#### MY FACILITIES: DRUG STOCK DOWNLOAD

Users should be able to download a CSV of the drug stock report for a given month.

The download link should generate a CSV that mirrors the current selections shown on the Dashboard view. It should essentially be the exact same table as the Dashboard, including columns for every drug/dose tracked, patient days remaining, and rows for each facility and total sums.
